JAXXON is a men's jewelry brand known for chains, bracelets, rings, and watches. It is set to open a new retail location at Fashion Valley Mall at 7007 Friars Road, San Diego, scheduled for Fall 2026, on the first level between Foot Locker and JD, across from Zara. The Fashion Valley opening marks the brand's continued expansion into brick-and-mortar retail.

PopUp Bagels is an East Coast bagel franchise that began as a pandemic project for founder Adam Goldberg and has grown to 42 locations nationally. It is planning a new location at 12184 Ventura Blvd in Studio City, with "coming soon" signage already up in the space. Franchise group Sweetzer Capital, helmed by James Marzouk, is behind the Studio City location under a 25-unit franchise agreement for Los Angeles and Orange County.

data.status: expected to open sometime in the second half of this year
data.short_description: Fairgrounds Coffee & Tea is a coffee and tea concept that initially opened in 2017 in Bucktown, founded by entrepreneur Michael Schultz. It is joining a new development at the ground floor of AmTrustRE's office tower at 1 E Wacker Drive, expected to open sometime in the second half of 2026. The concept currently serves River North, Millennium Park, Oak Park, Hyde Park, Highland Park, and North Loop, with additional cafes in Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Dallas.

Espiritu is a Mexican concept opening at the ground floor of AmTrustRE's office tower at 1 E Wacker Drive, Chicago. It will accompany Fairgrounds Coffee & Tea in the new development, with its opening set for fall 2026. The detail appears within the Fairgrounds Coffee article.

data.status: final day of service is scheduled for July 11
data.short_description: Shuggie's is a Mission District restaurant known for its colorful design and focus on reducing food waste, founded by Kayla Abe and David Murphy in 2022. The restaurant announced its closure on June 11 via Instagram, with the final day of service scheduled for July 11, 2026. The owners cited rising costs and lower foot traffic as the main reasons for the decision.

Clarke Bros. Subs is a sandwich restaurant located at 2545 Riverside Avenue in Jacksonville's Riverside neighborhood, known for specialty sandwiches such as 'The Duuuval' cheesesteak. The restaurant announced its upcoming closure on social media, with the final day of operation on June 20, 2026; it will operate from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. until then. The restaurant has been part of the community for nearly three years.

Good Intentions is St. Petersburg's first all-vegan-owned, full-service bar and restaurant and a perennial "Best of the Bay" winner for Best Vegan Restaurant. The restaurant announced its upcoming closure via social media, citing ongoing economic challenges, with the closure expected by mid-summer; the owners have yet to decide what will happen to the space. The closure follows the 2025 shutdown of its sister restaurant, Golden Dinosaurs.

data.short_description: Alma is a Balkan-inspired restaurant from Chef Vedran Jordan that pairs Balkan flavors with seasonal Pacific Northwest ingredients. The restaurant recently reopened following a short renovation period of about three weeks, introducing a refreshed dining room with antique furniture, family antiques, and decor from across the Balkans, along with a new All-You-Can-Enjoy dining experience at $55 per person. The redesign was led by Katie Horley, Marketing & Events Director at L3F Hospitality Group.

Tiny's Burger is a new restaurant concept from Chef Sang Yoon combining a classic American burger stand with a konbini-style snack shop inspired by Japanese convenience stores. The restaurant opened today at South Coast Plaza (Level 1 near Carousel Court) in Costa Mesa, serving items such as the Tiny's Burger with gochujang and ssamjang sauce, Tokyo Dog, and Miso Mac n Cheese. Chef Yoon is best known for creating Father's Office gastropubs, and the menu was developed alongside Chef Nanor Harboyan.

High Noon Brunchery is a Southern-inspired breakfast restaurant known as Georgia's first all-pink cafe, relocating from Douglasville to Buckhead. It will occupy a 4,000-square-foot space at 2285 Peachtree Road in Buckhead. The restaurant serves a menu including chicken and pancakes, lobster beignet omelette, and banana pudding French toast.

7 Brew is a drive-through coffee brand known for its highly customizable drink menu offering thousands of flavor combinations. Rocket Brew, Inc., a 7 Brew franchise group, is planning a new location at 4270 Lawrenceville Highway in Metro Atlanta, with plans to construct a new 897-square-foot drive-through building with two drive-through lanes. The brand's signature drinks include Blondie and Cookie-Butter Blondie.

data.location: White Oak Center (near Harbor Freight), Newnan, Georgia

It is relocating within White Oak Center to a 3,300-square-foot space near Harbor Freight, which will also include a coffee shop corner with a barista counter. No further address detail or opening date is provided in the article.

La Hacienda Mexican Restaurant is a Mexican restaurant chain that has been an area staple since 1996, with existing locations in Cordova, Collierville, and another in Germantown. The restaurant has submitted an application for a certificate of occupancy for a 3,000-square-foot space at 7730 Wolf River Boulevard in Germantown, with plans to decorate, paint, and bring furniture. This will be the chain's fourth location.

PacSun is a California-founded fashion retail chain offering casual wear, swimwear, and activewear, with over 300 stores across the country. It will be opening at Springfield Town Center at 6500 Springfield Mall, in a storefront located across from American Eagle, with the Springfield Town Center website stating it will be customer-ready this autumn. A precise opening date has not yet been announced.

Wonder is a rapidly expanding fast-casual food hall concept that works with celebrated chefs like Bobby Flay, Michael Symon, and José Andrés to recreate signature dishes under one roof. It is bringing a new location to 15443 Excelsior Drive in Bowie, with the company website stating it will be opening next month. Wonder has expanded to more than 50 locations since its debut in 2018.

The menu is overseen by chef Kevin LaCivita, a classically French-trained chef.

Joe and the Juice is a Danish juice, coffee, and sandwich café chain expanding in the DC area. The concept was founded by Vanderbilt University alumnus Stephen Finch, who launched Vagabond in London 16 years ago.

data.short_description: Mary's Gourmet Salads is a San Diego-based fast casual restaurant specializing in made-to-order salads, soups, and healthy fare. The company's third location is set to open in Bankers Hill at the corner of Sixth Avenue and Upas Street in the Park Summit building, though an exact opening date has not been announced. The expansion brings the brand beyond its existing locations in La Jolla and Ocean Beach.

Casa Vive is a new yoga studio and wellness concept described as offering movement, recovery, and community in one place. It recently received a permit for a $150,000 build-out at 1520 Prudential Drive, with contractor 8720 Cleaning Services LLC heading up the work. The studio was originally expecting a spring opening but that has not occurred; signs nonetheless point to the project moving forward.

data.short_description: IYKYK! Coffee Lab is an Orange County-based coffee brand that opened its first coffee lab in 2024 in Huntington Beach and later expanded to Costa Mesa. It is opening a new location at Marina Pacifica Shopping Center at 6324 E. Pacific Coast Highway in Long Beach, expected by the end of summer. The Long Beach location will feature the brand's newest design prototype, the Joyride Coffee Lounge, including a vinyl listening room with a mid-century modern design and outdoor patio.

data.location: 50 Place du Commerce, Magog, QC J1X 5G6, Canada
data.status: expects to be fully operational by July 1, 2026
data.short_description: La Buvette Shiso is a new restaurant and wine bar concept in downtown Magog led by Benjamin Pen, Charles Massicolli, and Dana Blumer, moving into the former home of Méli Smoked Meat. The team is currently operating a soft opening while awaiting its liquor permit and expects to be fully operational by July 1, 2026. The menu centers on pasta, fish, vegetables, wine, cocktails, and Quebec beers, with dishes sourced from local farms and rotating seasonally.

data.location: 406 W Belt Line Rd, Cedar Hill, TX 75104
data.short_description: Mija Barbecue is a family-owned barbecue restaurant in Cedar Hill, Texas that began as a backyard barbecue project in 2019 before growing into a brick-and-mortar business in 2024. The owners announced via social media that the restaurant will permanently close on June 27, 2026, without providing a specific reason. The restaurant, located at 406 W. Belt Line Road in a historic 1938 house, was known as one of the area's best-known family-run smokehouses.

Crackin Blue Crabs is an upcoming food truck that promises "All Flavor No Flex" and serves fried and grilled food. What Now came across plan review paperwork submitted by Crackin Blue Crabs LLC, but co-owner Latasha Armstrong was not immediately available for comment. No opening timeline or specific location has been confirmed.

Sheep is a new rooftop dining concept planned by Id Est Hospitality Group founder Kelly Whitaker, set to debut this summer at the Clayton Hotel & Members Club in Cherry Creek. It will operate as a three-month residency from July to October on the sixth-floor rooftop of the hotel at 233 Clayton Street. The concept offers a nightly four-course menu designed by Whitaker and chef Taylor Stark as an abbreviated, more accessible companion to The Wolf's Tailor.

McDonald's is opening a new location in Magog on Rue Sherbrooke, across from Walmart, expected to open in October 2026. Franchise owner Caroline Iannuzzi, who operates seven existing McDonald's restaurants across the Estrie region, will oversee the new restaurant. Construction is already underway on the vacant site, and the new restaurant will feature a design with greater emphasis on takeout, mobile ordering, and drive-thru service.

Gringos Tacos is an upcoming food truck serving Flagler County with a menu featuring birria tacos and ramen. What Now recently came across plan review paperwork for the food truck submitted by Dos Bros Foods LLC, but Chef Chris Gibbs was not immediately available for comment. No specific opening date or location has been confirmed.

data.status: ribbon-cutting ceremony is scheduled for June 18, 2026
data.short_description: Planet Fitness is one of the largest fitness center chains in the world, known for offering low-cost gym memberships. It has opened a new 21,141-square-foot fitness center at 3066 228th Avenue SE in Sammamish, which is the brand's 19th location in the Seattle-Tacoma area. A ribbon-cutting ceremony is scheduled for June 18, 2026, at 2 p.m.

Palazzo Pizza Italiana is a new pizza restaurant headed up by Jason Fox and the team at Josephine's Italian Market, set to open at 214 E Cass St in downtown Tampa. The space features a moody interior with a room-length bar and large semi-circular booths, filling a previously vacant spot on Cass Street. A previous instantiation of Palazzo Pizza on West Platt Street was active until May 2024.

data.location: Santa Fe Drive and Mineral Avenue, Littleton, CO
data.short_description: 1st Street Farms is a mixed-use development by Gastamo Group, a Colorado-based hospitality company, that will include a 15,000-square-foot full-service restaurant and a 13,000-square-foot event venue. The project is planned for a five-acre site along Santa Fe Drive and Mineral Avenue in Littleton, near South Platte Park. Littleton City Council approved a $5.5 million incentive package for the project, including a $2 million loan funded by business use tax revenues.

Hoff House Beer Garden Restaurant is a new beer garden concept planned for 1225 Seton Pkwy inside the Kyle Parkway Multi-Use Multi-Family Building No. 9, spanning approximately 7,500 square feet. Construction is projected to be completed in early August 2027, with the opening timeline not yet confirmed. The tenant listed is Zachary Ray, grandson of the founders of Austin's Original Hoffbrau Steakhouse.

Old Northeast Tavern is a bar and restaurant known for thin-crust New Jersey-style pizza, located at 201 Seventh Ave N in St. Petersburg. The tavern has been closed for almost two years and is expected to reopen later in 2026, with a few new menu items including burgers and fries alongside returning favorites. The space is co-owned by Robert Wareham and Mark Brindle, and has a long history of tenants dating back decades.

NomaEn is a Japanese dining concept centered around a 10-seat omakase bar led by Chef Taishi Noma, planned for 84 N. High St in Historic Dublin, Ohio. The concept is expected to open next spring and will also feature The Den, an upscale members-only lounge; membership applications are already being accepted. Oscar's Restaurant & Bar previously occupied the space for more than three decades before closing in early 2024.

Oscar's Restaurant & Bar was a long-standing restaurant at 84 N. High St in Historic Dublin, Ohio. It occupied the space for more than three decades before closing in early 2024. The site is now being redeveloped as NomaEn, a Japanese dining concept.
